passed.evidence: Validator requires selected_brigade_id, selected_brigade_location, and derived_sector_id to be null and all six diagnostic arrays to be empty. Nine one-field injection negatives cover every forbidden field.
Fresh Node 22 require exited 0 and exported detailErrors and validateFile without executing CLI dispatch. D has an explicit require.main guard.
D delegates non-not_reached semantic checks to C; C composes retained 203 checkRow on every completion. The final packet binds unchanged reader B and D by exact hashes.

blocking_finding.finding: The nine positive status controls are not valid producer-shaped records. The fixture constructor gives every non-bypass status null selected fields and empty arrays. Production selects a brigade and populates brigade_candidates before no_sector, missing_adjacency_or_friendly_set_or_location, empty_enemy_set, empty_direct_set, all_filtered, and generic_search; derived_sector_id is also populated for the latter five, and target arrays vary by the reached filter stage. Consequently the controls prove enum acceptance, not the claimed per-status contract.
blocking_finding.validator_limit: D adds exact semantics only for not_reached and delegates the remaining statuses to C, whose special cases are local_occupation_bypass and no_brigade. The other six producer statuses still share the generic branch.
blocking_finding.impact: The requested full per-status matrix versus producer source is unproved. This does not reopen the exact not_reached or require-safe findings, which are closed.
